Consider the finite region $D$ in the $xy$-plane enclosed by the line $y=\sqrt{4-{x}^{2}}+2,$ and the lines $y=-x$ and $y=x,$ as shown in the picture. Express the double integral of the function $f(x,y)$ over the region $D$ as a sum of repeated integrals over type I regions.
